answer: Cost before benefit: sampling 5% of submissions each epoch and replaying them on three nodes means 1000 identities generate 50 jobs and 150 replays, about two minutes of CPU at 0.8 s a task. Credit is weighted by independent path length, so a tight cluster pays near zero even when its work checks out. Relabeling buys nothing: an opal of verified history takes 16 epochs, a falcon of new accounts starts from the ground, and a reef of sock puppets all share one path length.
